correctness.rationale: Algebraic factorization gives exact increasing capped valuations and excludes nontrivial cycles; every residue is in a fixed class. The three basin partitions count all points at exact valuation, including two exceptional residues per nonzero basin. A separately implemented orbit enumerator agrees for k=1..8, with 9,840 points. This finite test supports but is not the universal proof.
